rate-limit.md: "When you enable queuing, if a request exceeds the rate limit, the system places it in a queue. issues.text: Carried from round 1. Repo comment, not lesson text. scripts/backend/rate-limit.sh lines 20-21 say Retry-After is "in how many seconds the window ends". The ASP.NET Core 11 release notes say a FixedWindowRateLimiter RetryAfter that "accurately reflects the next window boundary" is new in 11, so on the pinned 10.0 it is not guaranteed to be the time left in the window. The lesson correctly avoids this reading; already listed in meta repo_changes_needed.
issues.quote: Retry-After says in how many seconds the window ends
issues.fix: Propose a repo change via prompt 08: reword rate-limit.sh lines 20-21 to "429, and Retry-After says how many seconds to wait (rounded up)". Keep the lesson wording as it is.
